attempts.summary: Configured VRRP-based active/standby failover for a shared VIP (10.100.90.50/24 on br-lan) between node1 (OpenWrt, MASTER, priority 150) and node2 (OpenWrt, BACKUP, priority 100) using UCI-managed keepalived, persisted across reboot. Demonstrated node3 (Alpine) continuously reaching the VIP across a live transition when node1 stopped serving, and again on failback. Then performed the mandatory single-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, capturing changed boot IDs and post-restart recovery (VRRP re-election, VIP re-homing, node3 connectivity) for each.
